title: CLCON/220/2004 of HARPAL SINGH and ORS Vs RAVI SHANKER RAO and ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Civil Contempt No. 220 of 2004
Har Pal Singh, S/O Shri Kunwar Singh and six others.
...... Applicants.
Versus
Sri Ravi Shanker Rao, Divisional Sales Manager, Uttaranchal
Forest Corporation, Kankhal, Haridwar, District Haridwar and two
others. (Contemnors)
... Respondents.
 Sri S.K.Agrawal, Senior Advocate, with Sri Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel
for the applicants.
Sri V.K.Bist, Senior Advocate with Sri V.K.Kaparwan, learned counsel for the
respondents.
Date May 12, 2008.
Hon'ble B.S.Verma, J.
 Sri S.K.Agrawal, Senior Advocate, with Sri Jitendra
Chaudhary, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri V.K.Bist,
Senior Advocate with Sri V.K.Kaparwan, learned counsel for the
respondents.
 Sri S.D.Singh, Regional Manager (Garhwal)
Uttarakhand Forest Development Corporation, Kotdwar, is present
in person.
 Supplementary Counter Affidavit/Compliance Report
has been filed on behalf of the respondents. The same is taken on
record.
 This contempt petition has been filed to punish the
respondents for deliberately flouting the judgment and order dated
21-08-2003 passed by this Court in Writ Petition No. 1015 of 2001
(M/S) Harpal Singh and six others Vs. Presiding Officer, Labour
Court and three others.

2
 This Court had passed the order to the effect that "the
petitioners shall be put back on duty and shall be paid
salary/wages."
 So far as reinstatement of the petitioners is concerned,
the order has been complied with by the Regional Manager
(Garhwal) by his order dated 11-05-2008 (Annexure SCA-1).
 In the circumstances of the case, the contempt petition
is dismissed. Notices issued to the respondents are discharged. It
is provided that if the back wages are not paid by the respondents,
the petitioners would be at liberty to file fresh contempt petition
against the respondents.
All pending applications stand disposed of.
